item.title: Ohime-sama wa, Panthera Leo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hecate
  • 発売日: 2010-02-26
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: お姫様は、ぱんてられお
  • 英語名: Ohime-sama wa, Panthera Leo

あらすじ

Mamoru is a university undergrad who, being a hikikomori, doesn’t go to school unless absolutely necessary. One day in May, he was lectured by a prof due to his lousy attendance. He went to the roof for a breath of fresh air and while he was sitting on the bench and looking at the sky… a hole opened up in the sky! Out comes a lion princess, followed soon after by her brother and sister.

item.title: Horizon no Ue ~Yogen no Sho~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hecate
  • 発売日: 2009-05-01
  • スコア: 5.49/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ホリゾーンの上～預言の書～
  • 英語名: Horizon no Ue Yogen no Sho

あらすじ

This happened a long, long time ago.

There was a world covered in thick dark clouds.

But people from far-away lands came.

They were treated like gods, and rid the world of the dark clouds.

The ground overflowed with light, and new life sprouted.

Trees. Animals. Fish. Birds.

The gods had changed it all.
